jobs.title: Lead Coach and Program Coordinator - Tennis
jobs.description:
About us

Based in Westchester, Hot Shots Tennis runs afterschool and in-school tennis programs at elementary campuses in Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Venice, El Segundo, and Manhattan Beach. Some of our school partnerships go back more than nine years. Our USTA Net Generation-aligned curriculum includes Little Aces (K–2), Future Champs (grades 3–5), and our Level Up skill badge program.

The role

The Lead Coach & Program Coordinator leads classes at our school sites and spends about 6 hours a week on program coordination. The coordination time has flexible hours, can mostly be done remotely, and can be done in the mornings, before classes start at noon. You'll report to the Program Director.

Coaching responsibilities

* Lead afterschool and in-school classes at assigned school sites
* Deliver the Little Aces and Future Champs 10-week curriculum as written
* Run the Level Up badge program: assess skills, track progress, and award levels
* Keep sessions safe, organized, and fun, with a focus on beginners
* Follow each campus's check-in, dismissal, and pickup procedures
* Set up and pack up equipment at every session

Principal relationships and campus reservations stay with the Program Director. Log your coordination hours weekly.

What this role does not handle:

All financial matters are handled by the program's owners. This role has no access to or responsibility for:

* Tuition, payments, refunds, or invoicing
* Pricing, discounts, or contract terms with schools
* Payroll, timesheets beyond your own, or coach pay
* Budgets or purchasing (equipment requests go to the Program Director)
* Scholarships or financial aid

When a parent, school, or coach asks about any of these, reply: "I'll pass that along to our program office, and they'll follow up with you." Then forward the question the same day.

Qualifications

* Experience coaching youth tennis, ideally with elementary-age beginners
* Familiarity with USTA Net Generation (or willingness to get certified)
* Clear, friendly, and reliable written communication with parents and school staff
* Organized and comfortable with email, shared docs, and spreadsheets
* Reliable transportation between Westside and South Bay school sites
* Ability to transport gear for the classes in your vehicle if needed
* Able to pass a background check and meet school-site clearance requirements

Schedule, pay & how to apply

* **Schedule:** 15–17 coaching hours/week, scheduled between 12–4 pm on weekdays and 9–11:30 am on Saturdays, plus about 6 flexible coordination hours/week (about 21–23 hours/week total)
* **Pay:** $40–65/hr on court, depending on experience; $25/hr for coordination work; $80/hr for private lessons
* **Start date:** Mid-November 2026
* **To apply:** send a resume and a short note about your coaching experience to hotshotstennisorg1@gmail.com

Pay: $35.00 - $65.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Opportunities for advancement

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Junior Account Manager – Client Relations & Financial Advisory

**A strong start in business. Practical experience in finance. A career you can grow into.**

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA 90017  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, permanent  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid – in-office and remote work  
**Base Salary:** $65,000–$75,000 per year, depending on qualifications and experience  
**Annual Bonus:** Up to 15%, based on performance

Turn your interest in business into a professional career

Are you the person who keeps things organized, communicates well with others, and enjoys figuring out how things work? Would you like to apply those strengths in a business environment where you can learn about finance and work directly with clients?

Our team in downtown Los Angeles is looking for a **Junior Account Manager** to help coordinate client relationships and support financial advisory engagements.

We work with businesses that want to improve their financial operations, understand their cash flow, and manage working capital more effectively. You’ll help keep client projects organized, ensure information gets to the right people, and make it easier for our consultants to deliver useful solutions.

This is an opportunity to build a professional foundation in client management and financial consulting without needing extensive industry experience before you start.

What you’ll be doing

Your role will combine communication, coordination, and analytical support. You’ll learn our processes with guidance from experienced colleagues and gradually become more independent.

**Keep client relationships running smoothly**

* Help coordinate day-to-day communication with business clients.
* Respond to routine questions and make sure requests reach the appropriate team members.
* Arrange meetings, maintain follow-up lists, and communicate updates.
* Help ensure clients receive consistent, professional service.

**Help consulting projects stay on track**

* Coordinate schedules, documentation, and project milestones.
* Collect and organize information needed by financial consultants.
* Assist with preparing client presentations, reports, and meeting materials.
* Follow up on outstanding tasks and bring potential delays to the team's attention.

**Learn how financial advisory works**

* Support projects involving cash flow, liquidity, working capital, and treasury operations.
* Help organize financial information and prepare materials for analysis.
* Learn how consultants identify business needs and develop recommendations.
* Participate in discussions with colleagues to understand project objectives and outcomes.

**Make information useful**

* Maintain accurate client records in the CRM system.
* Update account activity, project progress, and follow-up items.
* Help prepare summaries and basic performance reports.
* Identify missing information and help keep documentation complete.

**Contribute ideas as you grow**

* Share client feedback and observations with your team.
* Help improve coordination and everyday processes.
* Support client onboarding and the transition into ongoing services.
* Take on additional account responsibilities as your experience develops.

What would make you a good fit?

We don't expect you to arrive as a financial expert. We want someone who can learn, communicate professionally, and take responsibility for getting things done.

**Education and experience**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Industrial Engineering, Political Science, or a related field.
* Approximately 0–2 years of professional experience.
* Recent graduates, candidates with internships, and applicants with relevant university projects are encouraged to apply.
* An interest in business consulting, financial services, banking, fintech, or corporate finance.

**Skills you can bring**

* Strong written and verbal communication in English.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage several tasks and meet deadlines.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, business documents, and digital tools.

Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, or another CRM system is helpful but not required.

Knowledge of cash flow, working capital, or corporate treasury is a plus. If these topics are new to you, you should be willing to learn them.

Additional language skills, including Spanish, Italian, French, or German, are welcome when supporting international clients.

**The qualities we value most:** curiosity, reliability, initiative, a professional attitude, and the ability to work well with others.

What you’ll gain from the experience

We want this position to help you build skills you can use throughout your career.

* **Competitive pay:** $65,000–$75,000 annual base salary.
* **Performance bonus:** Up to 15% annually, subject to the applicable bonus plan.
* **Structured onboarding:** Learn our services, systems, and client processes.
* **Professional guidance:** Work with experienced account managers and financial consultants.
* **Industry knowledge:** Develop practical exposure to financial advisory and business operations.
* **Career progression:** Build experience toward future Account Manager and Senior Account Manager opportunities.
* **Health benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

**Overview**

*Cultivating the American Dream* is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether it is helping residents call one of our communities home, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.

**The Role:**This role is responsible for assisting in all operational duties of the Community Manager, including reporting, rent processing, leasing, marketing, and overseeing the community and associates in the Community Manager's absence.

***The incumbent in this role must possess a high degree of professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.***

* **An Aptitude for Connecting -** Must possessa strong sense for creating a sense of community, as well as the drive to go the extra mile to create a positive experience for all residents and staff. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners, regulatory, and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistent, favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
* **An Authentic Attitude -** Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
* **An Approach that is positive and Professional** - Consistently demonstrate an approach of active listening and understand that your participation and support are integral to the success of Avanath, ensuring that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years' experience as an Assistant Community Manager.
* LIHTC/Tax Credit Program Knowledge required.
* Equipped with excellent communication skills and an unmatched dedication to customer service.
* Solid track record of bookkeeping and rent collection.
* Thorough understanding of landlord/tenant law.
* Strong Understanding of Fair Housing Laws.
* Superior interpersonal skills: ability to get along with diverse personalities; tactful; mature, flexible.
* Resourceful and organized.
* Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e-mail.
* Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management software.

**Key Accountabilities**

+ **Resident Relations + Customer Service**

* At all times, regardless, provides A+ customer service.
* Manages and promotes resident satisfaction and retention by responding to complaints, questions, and requests in a timely manner, and taking appropriate action to resolve and address service issues.
* Functions as a resource center for residents on all things that affect and may disturb their community-living experience and ability to make timely rent payments.
* Organizes and executes resident appreciation and retention events.
* Maintains a secure, confidential file for each resident.
* Answering phones, greeting walk-ins, and handling foot traffic.
* Assist with leasing job duties, including touring prospective residents.

+ **Fiduciary**

* Handles all the monies of the property. Collects, posts, and deposits rents/security deposits and other community income.
* Reviews resident files and ledger records to determine unpaid and/or late fees owed, communicates with residents regarding outstanding balances, implements procedures for collecting on delinquencies, and enforces the lease agreements.
* Assist with Monthly Projection Reporting, inspect vacancies, make-ready apartments, and models. Inspects the property for community policy violations, needed repairs, and overall landscaping.
* Meets regularly with Community Manager and Regional Manager to discuss community performance.
* Other duties as assigned by Community Manager.

+ **Staff Leadership**

* Maintains a service-oriented environment by always exhibiting a professional appearance and attitude.
* Oversees property operations and staff in Community Manager's absence.
* Support Leasing Consultants in the leasing of apartments and ensure that Fair Housing guidelines are followed.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.

+ **Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines**

* Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, *Americans with Disabilities Act,* and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
* Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.
* Follows the Company's established procedures related to evictions by following proper notice requirements, evicting residents, and representing the property as required in court hearings and eviction proceedings.

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions**

* The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
* Frequent sitting and walking.
* Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone.
* Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
* May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
* Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.

**How Avanath Supports You**

We know that our teams are the heart of our success and growth, and we are committed to showing our appreciation.

We offer:

* Culture Built on Purpose and Core Value

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator (Consumer Sales)
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

IGN Entertainment is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Consumer Sales team. You will be the central support hub for our team, keeping campaigns, renewals, and client relationships running smoothly from start to finish.

This is a unique opportunity to learn the digital advertising business from the ground up. This work is fast-paced, creative, and self-guided, with new problems to solve every day. If you have a passion for pop culture, a knack for organization, and the drive to take initiative, this is the perfect chance to build foundational skills and help shape how the world's largest brands, including Coca-Cola, Lego, Butterfinger, and Microsoft, engage with the future of pop culture.

* This is a hybrid role with an expectation to work in out offices 3 days per week. We are looking for candidates based in Los Angeles or New York City.
* This role is full-time, with an expectation to occasionally require work during evenings or weekends for client services, campaign reporting, and client entertainment/events. All candidates must be willing and able to work standard hours in the Eastern Time Zone.
* Some travel is required for this position to industry events and client meetings.
* This role involves standard office tasks, such as sitting at a computer. Additionally, travel and participation in industry events may require prolonged periods of standing and walking.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the central support hub and point of contact for our Sales Managers and Account Executives, ensuring they have what they need to succeed every day. This includes keeping proposals, wrap reports, and ad tags organized.
* Manage sales workstreams and campaigns from the start, tracking timelines and deliverables across multiple accounts at once.
* Take notes on internal and client calls, send clear recaps, and follow up on action items to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Partner with AEs to keep renewal timelines on track, pull performance data, and prepare materials that set up the next deal.
* Work with our Ad Ops team to check inventory availability across IGN's sites for client proposals and campaigns.
* Help execute campaigns by managing ad trafficking, performing quality assurance with Rev Ops on custom creative, and monitoring pacing. Build and send campaign reports directly to clients to ensure their expectations are met.
* Get up to speed on IGN's full suite of advertising products, including display media, branded content, video shows, social, and programmatic. You'll use this knowledge to help develop sales materials.
* Manage our reservation system and keep detailed records of business in Salesforce and other internal tools. Your attention to detail keeps our cross-functional teams (Ad Ops, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative Strategy, Client Services, and Design) aligned and informed.
* Help respond to RFPs by pulling research, securing ad inventory, and building visually appealing presentation materials.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

##### **The Must-Haves**

* You are highly organized and skilled at multitasking, with strong time management. You can prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment with ease.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal teams and external clients, and a keen eye for detail.
* You're a self-starter. You take initiative without being told what to do, figure out who to go to when you don't know the answer, and are comfortable tackling things you haven't done before.
* You're a natural problem solver who enjoys collaboration, and you'll learn to write clear, concise, and professional emails.
* You're coachable and curious. You ask good questions, welcome feedback, and bring a positive, team-first attitude to the work.
* You take thorough notes and follow up consistently.
* You're comfortable in Excel (sorting, filtering, and basic formulas) and PowerPoint (building clean, on-brand slides), and proficient in Google Workspace. You can quickly pick up new software and systems.

##### **Bonus Points**

* Experience in a sales, sales coordinator, media planning, or executive assistant role, in any industry.
* Prior experience at a media company or agency (digital media), or have an interest in pursuing a career in digital advertising and media.
* A deep passion for entertainment, gaming, and pop culture.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

IGN offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as life and disability benefits. Our employees enjoy Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), a 401(k) with company match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

**About FC Parking**  
FC Parking is a national leader in parking, transportation, and hospitality services, proudly serving hospitals, luxury residences, country clubs, hotels, and premier hospitality brands since 1998. Our team services over 150 locations across the U.S. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional service, operational efficiency, and innovative solutions tailored to each client’s unique needs.

**Why Join FC Parking?**

As a fast-growing, privately held Parking and Transportation Company, FC Parking offers the best of both worlds:  
**Agility Without Bureaucracy:**  
We’re a fast-scaling, privately held company — no VC or PE overlords setting unrealistic targets.

**Family Culture, National Reach:**  
Integrity, hustle, and loyalty define us — with national scale, brand reputation, and 25+ years of experience behind you.

**Executive Access:**  
Direct collaboration with the Director of Business Development and company officers. Your ideas won’t get buried—they'll shape the future.

**Innovation-Backed Selling:**  
Offer cutting-edge parking and hospitality solutions supported by proprietary technology and operational excellence.

**Uncapped Growth:**  
Top performers can build teams, lead departments, and carve their own career path as FC Parking expands.

* **Autonomy** – Run a full-cycle sales process and help shape strategic growth direction.
* **Innovation** – Sell cutting-edge parking and hospitality solutions backed by proprietary tech and a national support infrastructure.
* **Culture** – Join a values-driven team that prioritizes integrity, hustle, and customer experience.

**Position Summary**

We’re seeking a **Business** **Development Representative** to spearhead outbound prospecting across healthcare, luxury residential, and hospitality verticals. This is a senior leadership role where you’ll **own the****top of the funnel** and assist with the full cycle—from identifying and nurturing prospects to collaborating directly with sales leadership to shape FC Parking’s next stage of expansion.  
If you thrive on autonomy, want to build a high-performing sales pipeline, and seek an executive path within a fast-scaling company, **this is your opportunity.**

* **Drive Growth:** Develop and execute outreach to grow revenue across key verticals.
* **Own the Pipeline:** Build and manage a qualified pipeline using outbound prospecting, inbound lead conversion, partnerships, and event networking. Identify and qualify new business opportunities through outbound outreach, inbound leads, partnerships, and industry events. Including monitoring of government contract RFP announcements.

* **Represent the Brand**: Attend trade shows, conferences, and industry events to expand brand awareness and networks.
* **Leverage Technology:** Maintain detailed forecasting and reporting in HubSpot CRM and any other IT tools needed.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary:** $90,000 Base + incentive compensation targeting $120K–$140K total
* **Bonus & Incentives:** Performance-based bonus tied to qualified leads and closed deal kickers

* **Pipeline Incentives**: Consistent pipeline activity bonuses

**Benefits Include:**

* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* **No-cost** Layered Health benefits, including prescription coverage, urgent care, and telehealth for you and your family
* **No-cost** Cash-Value Life Insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off and holidays
* Professional development stipend
* Travel budget
* Laptop and tech allowance

* 3+ years of experience in B2B business development, enterprise sales, or client acquisition in the parking industry. Experience in a parallel or complementary industry will be considered for the right individual.
* Proven ability to build and manage a pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, and inbound opportunities.
* Strong financial and contract negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

jobs.title: Associate Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we're revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

The Strategic Growth team is central to our growth efforts, focused on identifying and engaging real estate professionals who align with our mission. As an Associate Sales Development Representative, AKA **Strategic Growth Associate** (SGA), you will play a foundational role in our growth, helping to navigate a dynamic industry with significant opportunity. Unlike roles requiring a focus on market fit, you will serve as a market-facing growth professional responsible for territory strategy, business discovery, competitive intelligence, and pipeline development. This role combines consultative outreach with strategic market analysis to support long-term business growth.

We are seeking individuals with strong business acumen and professional discipline to join our organization. You will interact with real estate agents across various geographies, conducting discovery to understand their business challenges and contribute to territory strategy. This is a role with high visibility, where success is measured through consistent performance against established metrics. We provide a structured environment with dedicated coaching and development; in return, we look for individuals who demonstrate accountability, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational excellence.

Based in our Beverly Hills office, this onsite role offers the opportunity to work alongside local teams and gain hands-on experience supporting the market.

**ROLE SPECIFICS**

* **Own Top-of-Funnel Pipeline:** Drive net-new pipeline through a strategic mix of inbound support and targeted outbound campaigns.
* **Consultative Discovery:** Conduct structured qualification calls to understand agent production, growth pain points, and business timelines.
* **Territory Strategy:** Lead day-to-day prospecting strategy for the territory; build multi-layered initiatives and execute micro-campaigns to drive market penetration.
* **Market Intelligence:** Serve as the pod's insight engine by documenting competitive intel, objection trends, and market sentiment to keep the CRM a powerful sales tool.
* **Value-Driven Engagement:** Articulate our value proposition through personalized, high-value communication; move fast and obsess about the opportunity
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with SGMs and Enablement to pilot new talk tracks, participate in role-plays, and refine the sales process.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree with 1+ years of relevant experience with history of strong performance (SDR, Direct Sales)
* Strong interpersonal and rapport-building skills, glass-half-full mentality, with demonstrated leadership potential
* Self-starter attitude and ability to exercise judgment and solve difficult problems without direct supervision, comfortable with ambiguity
* Highly motivated and persistent; energized by high-volume outreach and motivated by pushback, maintaining enthusiasm, professionalism, and momentum in a fast-paced environment
* Excellent communication skills; ability to effectively lead client meetings and presentations
* Highly organized; ability to handle multiple deadlines simultaneously
* Track record of excellence across strategic, operational, and detail-demanding functional responsibilities

**COMPENSATION**

The base pay range for this position is $31.25-$36.06 per hour ($65,000-$75,000 annualized); however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location.

**Perks that You Need to Know About:**

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

  

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

**About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

**The Role**

Onos is growing, and our health plan customers are growing with us. As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll be the go to person payers count on to make Onos work for them, and the person our product and operations teams count on to tell them what those payers actually need.

In this role you’ll manage real payer relationships, shape how we deliver value, and help set up the processes that let us scale without losing the personal touch.

**What you’ll own**

* Strategic payer relationships: you’re the day-to-day lead and trusted advisor for a portfolio of health plan customers

* Account initiatives and project execution: you drive them from kickoff to delivery, on time and with clear owners
* Scaling the account function: you help build the processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms that support our growth across Onos

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in strategic account management, product management, or client services
* Bonus if you have 1–2 years of management consulting experience
* Direct experience with healthcare payers, whether working at a health plan or managing health plan clients as a vendor or partner

jobs.description:
**ABOUT PALO ALTO FIT**

Palo Alto Fitness Club is Palo Alto's premier private personal training facility, home to a team of 30+ professional coaches dedicated to delivering exceptional, individualized training, a team that will grow to 50 in the next 12 to 18 months. Our 8,000 square foot appointment-only facility on California Avenue is designed exclusively for high-quality one-on-one coaching, and we are expanding to approximately 12,000 square feet in 2026/27, every square foot of it dedicated to personal training.

Our clients are professionals, families, and individuals who value expertise, privacy, and a highly personalized training experience. We are not a traditional gym. We are a professional training facility built on relationships, consistency, and long-term client success.

For more than 10 years, Palo Alto Fit has served individuals and families in Palo Alto and built a reputation for professionalism, a well-run studio, and exceptional client care, with more than 200 five-star Google reviews to show for it.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is one of the most critical roles in the studio. The Fitness Coordinator owns every new client's first ninety days with us, and the relationship after that. You conduct our Fitness Assessment yourself: you see how a person moves, you understand their injuries, limitations and goals, and you write the handover that lets our coaching team build the right program from day one. You match them to the right coach, carry them through their first weeks until training is a habit, check in with the client along the way, and work with the coach so the assessment and the program stay one plan. You sell the first package, you make every renewal happen, and you keep every client training. The first-renewal rate and the renewal rate are the measures of your work.

This is a role for someone with a Bachelor's or Master's in Kinesiology or Exercise Science who loves helping people, has real client-facing and sales experience, wants responsibility and is ready to carry it, likes a challenge, and can hold several things at once without dropping one: an assessment at ten, a renewal to close at eleven, a coach to brief in between, and a calendar of thirty coaches, soon fifty, that has to be right every day. The instinct to solve a problem the moment it appears, rather than pass it on, is the whole job. You are not coaching sessions, and you are not waiting for the phone to ring: you are on the floor assessing a prospective client or motivating a client mid-session, agreeing a client's next step with their coach, on the phone with a client who went quiet, and making sure a thirty-coach calendar is exactly right. Every new client's outcome has your name on it, and the owners will ask you, not the coaches, how the month went.

And you will work with everyone. In one day you may assess a twelve-year-old athlete with a parent beside them, a teenager preparing for a season, a founder between meetings, a physician from Stanford, a retired engineer coming back from surgery, and a family of four who train together. Each one needs a different conversation and the same standard of care, and you are the person who gives it to them.

The problems are real and they are yours: the client who paid and never started, the standing slot that quietly ran out, the client at five sessions left whose coach has not yet talked to them about renewing, the family sharing one package who want to know exactly how many sessions are left. Each one has a person behind it, and each one is solved by someone who reads the situation, picks up the phone, and sees it through.

The bar here is deliberately high. Everyone on this team earned their place, and that is exactly why they are proud to be here. If you are excellent at what you do, or serious about becoming excellent, you will be surrounded by people who hold the same standard.

**SELL: TURN A PROSPECT INTO A NEW CLIENT**

Be the first point of contact for prospective clients by phone, email, and in person, and the person who runs their first visit.

Conduct the **Fitness Assessment**, our 45-minute in-person consultation and intake for every prospective client: health and training history, a movement screen, a baseline body-composition scan, and the goal conversation. This is a consultation, not a training session, and you run it yourself.

**See and understand the client's limitations.** An old knee, a back that sits all day, a shoulder that will not go overhead, a nervous first-timer: you recognize what the body in front of you can and cannot do yet, and you ask the questions that surface what they did not think to mention.

**Explain to each client, in plain words, what the assessment showed and how we will get them started.** A hip or a knee that complains, for example: here is why, here are the muscles that need to get stronger first, and here are the exercises we begin with. They leave knowing exactly what their training will do for them.

**Guide each new client to the training package and membership that fit their goals, and complete their enrollment.** This is a consultative conversation, never a hard sell: you help people make a decision that is genuinely right for them, and the first package is your close.

Match each new client to the right coach, lock their standing weekly slot, and book their first session before they leave.

**Document the handover.** Everything the coach needs is on the client's profile before the first session: goals, history, limitations, what to protect, what the client wants to feel. A coach who reads your notes trains the client safely from minute one without the client repeating a word.

**KEEP: THE FIRST NINETY DAYS, AND THE RELATIONSHIP AFTER**

Send the welcome and the check-in emails on their day, and call any client who has not started or has gone quiet.

jobs.description:
**About TLC Nurse Solutions**

TLC Nurse Solutions is a women-owned California nurse registry thoughtfully coordinating experienced independent Registered Nurses (RNs) and Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVNs) with private-pay clients and healthcare partners throughout California.

Our Care Coordination & Office Operations Team is at the heart of that work. We coordinate referrals, schedules, communication, documentation, credentialing, and billing support while helping clients, nurses, and healthcare partners feel informed and well supported.

**About the Position**

This is a hands-on role within a collaborative, growing small business. Priorities can shift throughout the day as new referrals arrive, schedules change, or a client or nurse needs timely assistance. The right person enjoys bringing calm and organization to a responsive environment, takes genuine ownership of their work, and follows important details through to completion.

Every team member is cross-trained in TLC's core operations so we can support one another, provide dependable coverage, and continue improving how we work.

**What You Will Do**

· Coordinate new and ongoing nursing referrals, schedules, and coverage needs.

· Communicate professionally and compassionately with clients, families, independent nurses, specialty pharmacies, physicians, healthcare facilities, case managers, discharge planners, and other referral partners.

· Respond to phone calls, emails, text messages, and faxes in a timely and organized manner.

· Manage schedule changes, cancellations, urgent coverage requests, and other time-sensitive needs.

· Review nursing documentation for completeness and process it promptly.

· Assist with client invoicing, contractor invoice processing, and related follow-up.

· Maintain accurate scheduling, credentialing, compliance, and operational records.

· Follow written Standard Operating Procedures while helping identify practical workflow improvements.

· Support teammates and participate in shared evening, weekend, and holiday on-call coverage.

**Who Thrives Here**

People who thrive at TLC care about doing things well, helping others, and contributing to the organization as a whole. They tend to:

· Take ownership, show initiative, and follow responsibilities through to completion.

· Stay organized, responsive, and attentive to details while managing multiple priorities.

· Enjoy figuring things out, connecting the pieces, and learning how different parts of the work fit together.

· Communicate clearly, warmly, kindly, and proactively with clients, nurses, healthcare partners, and teammates.

· Remain calm, thoughtful, and solution-focused when circumstances change or something unexpected comes up.

· Use sound judgment, make confident routine decisions, and ask thoughtful questions when collaboration is helpful.

· Notice what needs attention and help move it forward rather than waiting for every next step to be assigned.

· Take pride in becoming knowledgeable, capable, and dependable in their work.

· Bring a positive, helpful attitude and genuinely enjoy contributing to a collaborative team.

· Value teamwork, flexibility, accountability, continuous learning, and exceptional client service.

**Qualifications**

· **Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) preferred.**

· Strong organizational, written communication, and verbal communication skills.

· Comfort managing multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and follow-through.

· Ability to work independently and contribute to a close, collaborative team.

· Comfort learning scheduling, credentialing, documentation, communication, and office systems.

· Healthcare administration, care coordination, scheduling, office operations, or customer service experience is helpful.

Healthcare experience is valuable, and we place equal importance on judgment, emotional intelligence, professionalism, adaptability, curiosity, and a genuine sense of responsibility.

**Schedule, Compensation & Benefits**

The Armenian General Benevolent Union was established in 1906 and is the world’s largest non-profit organization devoted to preserving and promoting the Armenian identity and heritage through educational, cultural, and humanitarian programs. Founded in 1963, Camp Nubar is a six-week sleep-away summer camp located on its 365-acre home in the Catskill Mountains region of New York State. Each summer over 300 campers from all over the world (Canada, Europe, Eurasia, all across America) call Camp Nubar their home away from home. Camp Nubar has state-of-the-art facilities, a varied program, and is proud to offer a rich cultural experience in an environment that rivals the best privately owned summer camps in America. Delish is looking for a highly organized and creative Temporary Video Production Coordinator to help bring entertaining, high-quality food content to life across YouTube, social, and other video platforms. In this role, you’ll keep productions moving from kickoff through final delivery, partnering with producers, crews, talent, and internal teams to make every project run smoothly.

**About Hearst Magazines (Why Us?)**

Hearst Magazines is one of the largest publishers in the world, with more than 25 brands, including Cosmopolitan, ELLE, Esquire, Good Housekeeping, Harper’s BAZAAR, Popular Mechanics, and Delish We reach more than 150 million people every month in the United States alone. But we’re more than just our magazines. We engage our audience across all mediums and channels—print, digital, video, and social—with sophisticated content creation, distribution, and data capabilities. We create, package, and sell products with cutting-edge technology and proprietary platforms. Together, we are reinventing publishing for the 21st century.

**Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)**

* Coordinate schedules, logistics, and production needs across multiple shows and freelance producers, keeping documentation current and accessible to stakeholders.
* Lead project kickoffs and maintain production timelines, documentation, and clear communication around deadlines, priorities, and changes.
* Track creative deliverables, including treatments, outlines, scripts, and other materials, from development through production.
* Book crew and coordinate equipment, locations, travel, catering, and other shoot logistics to ensure productions are fully prepared.
* Prepare call sheets and communicate shoot details, schedules, and logistics to internal teams, talent, and production partners.
* Partner with Operations to support production processes, budgets, production costs, crew outreach, invoices, and related administrative needs.
* Track post-production schedules, creative notes, revisions, and deliverables through final versions.
* Support productions on set, including load-in and strike, while working professionally and collaboratively with talent and crews.
  

**Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)**

* 2+ years of experience in video production, production coordination, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with digital video production workflows from creative development through post-production.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Clear, proactive communication skills and the judgment to flag potential delays, identify solutions, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with freelance producers, talent, internal teams, external crews, and other production partners.
* Familiarity with call sheets, crew bookings, equipment workflows, budgets, invoices, and production clearances.
* Professional discretion, strong research skills, and an interest in food, entertainment, and digital media.
* Ability to work in New York City four days per week or work remotely.
  

The base salary range for this role is $30-$40 per hour. This position is not eligible for bonus or commission compensation. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Hearst Magazines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Event & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Before You Apply...**
-----------------------

This is Kaizen's first dedicated events hire, and it's a build role. Our events have been run part time alongside other responsibilities. We have a conference presence, a set of shows we return to, and a handful of rooms that have worked well, but no owner and no playbook. You'll set the strategy, own the calendar and the budget, and be accountable for what the program produces.

The center of the role is the federal conference circuit: the Washington-area shows and agency-facing conferences where our federal buyers gather, the field motion that surrounds them, and the executive dinners and briefings we run alongside them. State and municipal events sit underneath the federal calendar rather than beside it. Kaizen-hosted events are a real ambition and you'll scope what we should own, but that work follows the circuit rather than leading it.

Events at Kaizen are a growth function, measured against pipeline and qualified meetings rather than attendance. Our buyers are public servants, and how we show up in a room is a direct statement about the quality of what we build. Politics is not a criterion at Kaizen: we don't screen for ideology, and we expect you to build trusted relationships on both sides of the aisle.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You've built an events program rather than inherited one, owning the strategy, the budget, the vendor bench, and the measurement
* You know the federal conference landscape, or you'll learn it quickly, and you can tell a show that draws program offices and CIOs from one that only draws vendors
* You have strong taste and can defend it. You've walked a venue and known it was wrong, and you've ended a sponsorship everyone assumed would renew
* You think in pipeline rather than attendance, and you've defended an events budget with something more rigorous than photos and a headcount
* You're comfortable in the operational detail: shipping, badge scans, AV failures, staffing, and the seating chart that determines whether a dinner works
* You're credible with senior government audiences, from a two-star Army general to an agency CIO to a contracting officer
* You manage vendors, agencies, and production partners by directing their output rather than depending on it
* You thrive with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, and you self-generate the agenda rather than waiting for one
* You're AI-pilled and default to these tools in your daily workflows
* You're emotionally intelligent, thoughtful, and empathetic toward public sector missions

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own Kaizen's events strategy end-to-end.** Build and run the annual calendar, anchored to the federal buying year: fiscal year-end, agency budget windows, and the conferences where our buyers actually show up
* **Decide where Kaizen shows up and where it doesn't.** Evaluate conferences and sponsorships, negotiate levels and booth placement with organizers, and be willing to walk away. A defensible no matters as much as a good yes
* **Own our physical presence.** Booth design, demo staging, collateral, and swag that match the caliber of the product, along with the vendors and production partners who build them
* **Run the field motion alongside sales.** Account targeting, pre-event outreach, on-site meeting scheduling, team travel and staffing, and the follow-up that determines whether the show produced anything
* **Own the satellite program around major shows.** Executive dinners, agency roundtables, and closed-door briefings, most of them in Washington, where the highest-value conversations often happen off the show floor
* **Land Kaizen leadership on stage and in the content.** Speaker placement, panel submissions, and awards in partnership with Brand & Storytelling and Government Affairs, with photo, video, and customer story capture planned into the run-of-show
* **Scope and build Kaizen-hosted events.** Define what we should own, whether a summit, a dinner series, or a recurring briefing, and determine whether we host it outright or co-host with a govtech company, consulting firm, or systems integrator
* **Own the budget and the reporting.** Manage spend and tradeoffs across the program, and build reporting with BizOps that ties events to pipeline, qualified meetings, and cost per meeting
* **Navigate federal ethics rules.** Gift and hospitality limits vary by agency and shift again at the state and local level. Work with Legal to design programs that are both generous and compliant

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 4-10 years in events, experiential marketing, or field marketing, with direct ownership of strategy and budget rather than execution alone
* Demonstrated experience owning a conference circuit: which shows to commit to, what a sponsorship is worth, how a booth gets built, and how the week runs
* Experience running ev

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Role**
------------------

Hello Patient is hiring a Strategic Account Manager to own the health, retention, and growth of our customer accounts from signature through post-go-live. You will be the primary relationship holder for your accounts, responsible for ensuring customers consistently realize value from Mia, identifying risks early, and helping customers expand how they use HelloPatient over time.

This is a proactive, ownership-driven role. You’ll maintain a clear, up-to-date understanding of how each account is performing, monitor key signals to catch issues before they escalate, and partner closely with internal teams to drive resolution.

Customers should view you as a trusted partner, essentially an extension of their team who understands their business, not just a point of contact for a software vendor.

While you’ll stay involved during the initial implementation to establish the relationship and ensure smooth handoffs and communication, your core responsibility ramps up after go-live to own the customer experience, manage communication and expectations, and be accountable for long-term customer success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Own Account Health**

* Track how the agents are performing across your accounts, including containment, transfers, and reschedule, cancel and confirm rates. Dig into anything unusual before the customer notices it.
* Review call logs and transfers to find where the agent falls short, and suggest fixes to the call flow.
* Turn issues into clear tickets for Product and Engineering, follow them through to resolution, and keep customers updated along the way.

### **Manage Customer Relationships**

* Be the day-to-day point of contact for your accounts. Build a trusted advisor relationship so customers see you as part of their team, not just a vendor contact.
* Run regular check-ins and program reviews, and send a clear status recap after each one.
* Support customers through soft launch, go-live and ongoing agent updates, like new locations, providers, voice and script changes.
* Work with Product, Engineering, QA, Sales and Solutions to get customers what they need, and wear whatever hat the day calls for.
* Join onsite visits, whiteboarding sessions and industry events.

### **Drive Performance & Growth**

* Build recurring performance reports and use them to help customers understand the value they're getting from Mia.
* Help build ROI models from customer data and turn them into clear stories for customer leadership.
* Spot expansion opportunities, such as new agents, chatbot, billing, referrals and new locations, and help Sales and Solution Engineers scope them.
* Support order forms, renewals and invoicing follow-up.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Must have:**

* 3+ years in account management, customer success or a similar client-facing role.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can read between the lines, build excitement and handle pushback with confidence.
* A strong storyteller who can turn data into a clear story about value.
* Collaborative and works well with cross-functional teams. You're happy to wear multiple hats.
* Strong attention to detail, so nothing falls through the cracks between customers and internal teams.
* Comfortable with data. You can work in spreadsheets, read dashboards and explain what the numbers mean.
* Proactive and comfortable with ambiguity. You know when to solve a problem yourself and when to escalate.
* You love building from the ground up. You're open to change, can pivot quickly and do well in a fast-paced startup.

### **Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare, health tech or working with medical practices.
* You use AI or automation tools every day to work faster.
* Background in practice operations, revenue cycle or patient scheduling.
* Some exposure to SQL, BI tools or call center metrics.

**Compensation**
----------------

**Base salary:** $80K–$110K

**Equity:** Meaningful ownership in a fast-growing healthtech startup  
  
**About Hello Patient**

Hello Patient is transforming healthcare communication through advanced conversational AI. Our founding team spent 3.5 years scaling Carbon Health's technology during hypergrowth, where we saw firsthand how much clinical time gets wasted on basic communication—great clinicians buried in admin work, patients stuck in phone tag.

Our AI platform proactively engages patients through perfectly timed calls and texts, resolving complex interactions end-to-end—from scheduling to billing to retention. Built with security and compliance at its core, our technology integrates with existing healthcare infrastructure to deliver 24/7 patient engagement.

Backed by Scale and 8VC, we're building the future of healthcare communication, one conversation at a time.

Compensation Range: $80K - $110K

**Why Canopy USA?**

Canopy USA is now positioned to consolidate operations across its three business units – Wana, Jetty, and Acreage – realizing synergies, cost savings, and supporting growth in state-legal markets across the U.S.

Through coverage of key market segments including flower via Superflux, vape and concentrates via Jetty, edibles and beverages via Wana, and retail through The Botanist, Canopy USA is well positioned to accelerate growth with an emphasis on the Midwestern and Northeastern U.S. markets

  

**Who you’ll work for:** ***HSCP Service Company LLC***

**Our Culture:**

Here at ***Canopy USA*** we believe in people first. We value our people and encourage continuous opportunities to learn, develop, and grow. We pride ourselves in innovation and passion for the cannabis industry.

We are always looking for motivated people who share our vision to join our team. Think you have what it takes? Then come grow with us!

  

**About the Role:**

The Territory Account Manager position will have a significant presence representing all company and related subsidiaries and affiliate company brands and executes sales and promotions that align with our brands goals. This role is a multi-dimensional position covering areas of sales, marketing, brand awareness, strategy and acting as a liaison between customers and our brands and related company brands. This role plays a critical component in driving growth, sales, and awareness of our brands and company-related brands.

The Territory Account Manager will find, connect with, and qualify leads. Have an in-depth understanding of our brands and company-related brands portfolio in their region and clearly present product differentiators to prospects, while overcoming objections, successfully closing sales, and nurturing a geographic database. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, revenue-driven, and looking to grow long term with Canopy USA. They are invested in personal development and embrace the philosophy of servant selling - doing things for your customers and prospects that they perceive to be of value.

They provide the leadership team with an analysis of market conditions, competitive forces, customers, and market needs in addition to the sales resources required to meet their revenue targets. Duties will focus on selling as #1 priority and building relationships with their accounts. Strong communication with retail partners and regular updating to management required. This is a great opportunity with a competitive base salary, plus eligibility for quarterly bonus incentive!

  

**How you’ll make a difference:**

* #1 Priority: Grow Sales, Build Key Account Relationships, and Drive Revenue for their territory in Long Island/Brooklyn/Queens/Staten Island, NY
* Conduct and analyze market research to determine opportunities, trends, and risks in the territory/market.
* Clearly define and assess market opportunities and develop go-to-market strategy.
* Continually evaluate our brands and company related brands commercial sales approach.
* Be a strong brand representative and drive new business through strong relationships, communication, and strategies that will benefit both Canopy USA and our accounts.

* Represent our brands and company related brands at industry events, conferences, and tradeshows.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and goals. Eligibility for incentive bonus compensation targeted at 30% of annual base salary.
* Partner with Field and Trade Marketing team to execute and support our accounts with marketing initiatives and events.
* Lead, deploy, and manage in store visual execution and brand standards.
* Develop, collect and share monthly marketing and sales recaps with key stakeholders.
* Manage territory budget with Regional Sales Director for promotions, swag, travel, and account engagement, accurately estimate costs, and manage execution.
* 80% of time spent in field expectation.

Supervisory Responsibility:  
This position has no direct reports or supervisory responsibility.

  

**Skills to be Successful:**

Education & Experience:

* Experience in Sales/Business Development and/or marketing, preferably within the cannabis industry but not limited to.
* Experience working directly with customers.
* Track record of successful delivery against revenue and other quantitative goals.
* Proven ability to perform in high-visibility, high-growth environments.
* Prior experience with pop ups and promotions a plus.
* Sales experience required.
* Cannabis industry sales experience a plus

Additional Qualifications:

* Must have the ability to organize, implement and maintain sales strategies and programs.
* Should possess outstanding presentation and communication skills.
* Results oriented team player with thorough business fundamentals.
* Must be hands-on and willing to drive new business and work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal skills.
* Proficient technical skills including use of MS Office, CRM software, and Canva.
* Flexible schedule and ability to work some weekends and evenings.

**Work Authorization/Security Clearance**

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator (Consumer Sales)
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

IGN Entertainment is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our Consumer Sales team. You will be the central support hub for our team, keeping campaigns, renewals, and client relationships running smoothly from start to finish.

This is a unique opportunity to learn the digital advertising business from the ground up. This work is fast-paced, creative, and self-guided, with new problems to solve every day. If you have a passion for pop culture, a knack for organization, and the drive to take initiative, this is the perfect chance to build foundational skills and help shape how the world's largest brands, including Coca-Cola, Lego, Butterfinger, and Microsoft, engage with the future of pop culture.

* This is a hybrid role with an expectation to work in out offices 3 days per week. We are looking for candidates based in Los Angeles or New York City.
* This role is full-time, with an expectation to occasionally require work during evenings or weekends for client services, campaign reporting, and client entertainment/events. All candidates must be willing and able to work standard hours in the Eastern Time Zone.
* Some travel is required for this position to industry events and client meetings.
* This role involves standard office tasks, such as sitting at a computer. Additionally, travel and participation in industry events may require prolonged periods of standing and walking.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the central support hub and point of contact for our Sales Managers and Account Executives, ensuring they have what they need to succeed every day. This includes keeping proposals, wrap reports, and ad tags organized.
* Manage sales workstreams and campaigns from the start, tracking timelines and deliverables across multiple accounts at once.
* Take notes on internal and client calls, send clear recaps, and follow up on action items to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Partner with AEs to keep renewal timelines on track, pull performance data, and prepare materials that set up the next deal.
* Work with our Ad Ops team to check inventory availability across IGN's sites for client proposals and campaigns.
* Help execute campaigns by managing ad trafficking, performing quality assurance with Rev Ops on custom creative, and monitoring pacing. Build and send campaign reports directly to clients to ensure their expectations are met.
* Get up to speed on IGN's full suite of advertising products, including display media, branded content, video shows, social, and programmatic. You'll use this knowledge to help develop sales materials.
* Manage our reservation system and keep detailed records of business in Salesforce and other internal tools. Your attention to detail keeps our cross-functional teams (Ad Ops, Revenue Operations, Finance, Creative Strategy, Client Services, and Design) aligned and informed.
* Help respond to RFPs by pulling research, securing ad inventory, and building visually appealing presentation materials.

**Job Qualifications**
----------------------

##### **The Must-Haves**

* You are highly organized and skilled at multitasking, with strong time management. You can prioritize competing tasks in a fast-paced environment with ease.
* You have strong written and verbal communication skills with both internal teams and external clients, and a keen eye for detail.
* You're a self-starter. You take initiative without being told what to do, figure out who to go to when you don't know the answer, and are comfortable tackling things you haven't done before.
* You're a natural problem solver who enjoys collaboration, and you'll learn to write clear, concise, and professional emails.
* You're coachable and curious. You ask good questions, welcome feedback, and bring a positive, team-first attitude to the work.
* You take thorough notes and follow up consistently.
* You're comfortable in Excel (sorting, filtering, and basic formulas) and PowerPoint (building clean, on-brand slides), and proficient in Google Workspace. You can quickly pick up new software and systems.

##### **Bonus Points**

* Experience in a sales, sales coordinator, media planning, or executive assistant role, in any industry.
* Prior experience at a media company or agency (digital media), or have an interest in pursuing a career in digital advertising and media.
* A deep passion for entertainment, gaming, and pop culture.

**Our Benefits**
----------------

IGN offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as life and disability benefits. Our employees enjoy Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), a 401(k) with company match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

We are committed to work-life balance with Flexible Time Off, Volunteer Time Off, and paid holidays. We offer family building and caregiving support and generous Family Care and Parental leave, when you need it. We also provide Fitness Reimbursement and access to wellness programs, ensuring our team stays healthy both physically and mentally.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.

If you're seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then IGN Entertainment is the place for you.

**About IGN Entertainment**

**COME JOIN OUR TEAM!**

**OUR TEAM**

Maverick Studios is where creativity meets impact. As the in-house agency for Inspire Brands, we craft award-winning work that spans design, video, photography, print, and beyond. Serving six iconic brands—Arby’s, Buffalo Wild Wings, Baskin-Robbins, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and Sonic—our team is a powerhouse of collaboration and passion. **ABOUT THE ROLE**  
Do you thrive on organization, coordination, and keeping complex projects moving? As a **Traditional Marketing Project Coordinator** at Maverick Studios, you'll play a critical role in supporting the execution of traditional marketing initiatives across multiple Inspire Brands.

From point-of-purchase materials and menu systems to packaging updates, photo shoots, promotional merchandising, and in-store marketing collateral, you'll help ensure projects are accurately built, tracked, routed, and delivered from intake through final production.

You'll partner closely with Project Managers, Account Managers, Creative teams, Proofreading, Brand Marketing partners, and external vendors to support the successful delivery of marketing assets that appear in restaurants across the country.

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

* **Traditional Marketing Intake Partner:** Review incoming marketing requests (e.g., POP, packaging, menus, photo shoots, merchandising, print collateral, promotions, etc.) for completeness and accuracy before building in Workfront.
* **Workfront Builder:** Set up traditional marketing projects, align timelines, assign tasks, and track deliverables through completion.
* **Production Coordinator:** Support the execution of packaging, menu, POP, and marketing collateral projects by coordinating assets, approvals, specifications, and production requirements.
* **Feedback Router:** Capture and route feedback from Brand Marketing, Client Relations, Creative, Proofreading, and Production partners to ensure revisions are documented and communicated clearly.
* **Asset Tracker:** Maintain project documentation, version control, routing records, and asset libraries within Workfront, SharePoint, and other team systems.
* **Photo Shoot Support Partner:** Assist with planning and coordination activities for photo shoots, including project setup, timelines, asset collection, deliverables tracking, and post-shoot organization.
* **Delivery Manager:** Upload, distribute, and archive final files to approved repositories and distribution channels.
* **Accuracy Advocate:** Ensure all assets, specifications, and supporting documentation are properly labeled, organized, QA'd, approved, and finalized before release.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* **Experience:** 1-2 years in a marketing, creative operations, project support, production coordination, or agency role (internship or entry-level experience counts).
* **Tool Readiness:** Familiarity with Workfront, Smartsheets, SharePoint, or similar systems, or a strong eagerness to learn quickly.
* **Production Awareness:** Basic understanding of traditional marketing deliverables such as packaging, menus, POP materials, photo shoots, print production, and marketing collateral.
* **Organized Mindset:** A love of lists, timelines, status updates, and keeping projects neat, tidy, and trackable.
* **Communication Skills:** Clear and proactive communicator who can manage updates across multiple stakeholders and project teams.
* **Detail Obsessed:** You catch the small things (file names, version control, specifications, deadlines, and approvals) that keep projects running smoothly.
* **Collaborative Spirit:** A team-first attitude. You're dependable, approachable, and always willing to lend a hand.

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT HERE**

* **People-First Culture:** Join a supportive, collaborative team that values growth and shared wins.
* **Creative Exposure:** Learn the inner workings of a full-service in-house agency and contribute to projects for six iconic brands.
* **Career Growth:** Build foundational project management skills with clear pathways to grow into Project Manager and beyond.
* **Team Spirit:** Expect kudos, brainstorms, and plenty of snacks along the way.
* **Perks & Personality:** Free ice cream, cold brew, and a beer/wine wall fuel the fun.

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 4 years – Bachelor’s Degree
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related fields and/or experience working in a brand marketing role or agency environment

  
Inspire is a multi-brand restaurant company whose portfolio includes more than 33,000 Arby’s, Baskin-Robbins, Buffalo Wild Wings, Dunkin’, Jimmy John’s, and SONIC restaurants worldwide.  
  
We’re made up of some of the world’s most iconic restaurant brands, but we’re much more than just a restaurant company. We’re a team of hundreds of thousands who individually and collectively are changing the way people eat, drink, and gather around the table. We know that food is much more than a staple—it’s an experience. At Inspire, that’s our purpose: to ignite and nourish flavorful experiences.

jobs.description:
**Purchasing Operations Coordinator**
=====================================

**About Local Eclectic**
------------------------

Local Eclectic is a Chicago-based fine jewelry company operating five proprietary brands (Family Gold, For You With Love, Harvest Moon, Carried Jewels, Period Piece), with wholesale partnerships including Nordstrom, Anthropologie, and Free People. We have now expanded beyond e-commerce with a flagship retail store and café opening at 212 E. Ontario in downtown Chicago — adding an in-person, high-touch dimension to a highly engaged, authentic customer base.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Purchasing Operations Coordinator manages the administrative execution and tracking of purchase orders from placement through final receipt. This role ensures purchase orders are accurately created and maintained in GoodDay, delivery timelines are up to date, and communication flows smoothly between vendors, Buying, Demand Planning, Warehouse Operations, and Accounts Payable.

Serving as the primary point of contact for PO-related vendor communication, this person monitors incoming shipments, coordinates receiving and discrepancy resolution with the warehouse, and ensures purchase orders are accurately reconciled and closed in the system. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple orders and follow-ups at once.

------------------------

* Create and issue purchase orders in GoodDay once orders are approved by Buying, ensuring all order details are accurate and complete.
* Send purchase orders to vendors for confirmation and resolve administrative questions or discrepancies.
* Maintain GoodDay as the central source of truth for PO details, vendor contacts, order statuses, and expected ship and arrival dates.
* Keep PO statuses and delivery timelines current, proactively flagging delays, changes, and exceptions to the appropriate teams.
* Coordinate order updates, split shipments, and delivery timing changes with Buying and Demand Planning as needed.

### **Vendor Communication & Coordination**

* Serve as the primary contact for vendors regarding purchase orders, order confirmations, shipping timelines, tracking, receiving discrepancies, and outstanding operational questions.

### **Shipping, Receiving & Warehouse Coordination**

* Monitor incoming purchase orders and maintain visibility into expected deliveries and shipment tracking.
* Communicate incoming shipments and changes in arrival timing to Warehouse Operations, helping the team prioritize receipts based on business needs.
* Partner with Demand Planning and vendors to coordinate and stagger incoming shipments, smoothing receipt timing to maintain a steady flow of inventory and avoid large, concentrated deliveries whenever possible.
* Serve as the primary communication link between vendors and the warehouse when delivery, receiving, or order questions arise.
* Confirm with Warehouse Operations that purchase orders have been received and that quantities align with the original order.
* Investigate missing, incorrect, damaged, or otherwise discrepant quantities with the warehouse and vendors, escalating unresolved issues as needed.
* Close purchase orders in GoodDay once receipt has been confirmed and discrepancies have been resolved or appropriately documented.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination & Accounts Payable**

* Partner with Accounts Payable to address PO-related questions, receiving discrepancies, and outstanding vendor payment inquiries.
* Ensure purchase orders accurately reflect confirmed orders and final receipts so Accounts Payable has the information needed to process invoices and payments.
* Coordinate with vendors and Accounts Payable on outstanding payment questions, helping identify missing information or documentation and route issues to the appropriate owner.
* Communicate recurring delivery issues, outstanding discrepancies, and other exceptions to Buying, Demand Planning, and relevant stakeholders.

------------------

* 1–2 years of experience in purchasing coordination, buying operations, merchandising, inventory administration, logistics, or a related field preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Comfortable working across multiple systems, spreadsheets, and administrative processes.
